items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 10 at 1:51AM PDT until October 11 at 9:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Hazardous sea conditions.

* WHERE...Portions of the coastal waters of southwest California.

* WHEN...From 6 PM Saturday to 9 PM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
